questions.questionText: Which of the following is the most appropriate title for the passage? (Passage: “Lakes of Bengaluru”)
options: A City That Forgot Its Water
Why Monsoons Fail in the South
questions.explanation: The passage is about the decline of the lake system and the cost of forgetting it. The other titles pick minor details or are not discussed.
